name: moonrepo
description: moonrepo multi-language workspace: task runner, project graph, toolchain, and cached builds.
must: Run tasks through moon (`moon run <target>`) to utilize dependency graph and build caching.
Define tasks with explicit `inputs` and `outputs` in `moon.yml` or `.moon/tasks.yml` to maintain deterministic caching.
never: Commit `.moon/cache/` directories or temporary build artifacts.
docs: https://moonrepo.dev/docs — official moon documentation. Read it before changing .moon/ configs or tasks.
`moon <command> --help` — check CLI syntax and flags before executing.
